How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech./ B.E. in specific engineering or physics fields with a minimum CGPA of 7.0/10 or 70%, along with a valid GATE scorecard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the email is sent before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. Which departments are eligible for this Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Eligible departments include Electronics and Communication Engineering, Materials Science Engineering, Materials Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Physics Engineering, and Applied Physics Engineering.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Roorkee offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.
